```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
vars <- 
  read_csv('variants.csv', col_types = cols()) %>% 
  mutate(variant_id = str_c(SYMBOL, ' ', HGVSg))
```

```{=html}
<!-- ── HTML Layout Start ──────────────────────────────────── -->
<div class="container">
  <div id="sidebar">
    <h2>Variants</h2>
    <ul id="variant-list"></ul>
  </div>
  <div id="main-content">
```

```{=html}
<!-- ── Gene Info Section ────────────────────────────────── -->
<details markdown="1" id="gene-info">
  <summary>GENE INFO</summary>
  <div id="gene-body">
```

```{r, results='asis'}
# ── Gene Panels: wrap child QMD outputs ──────────────────
for(i in seq_len(nrow(vars))) {
  variant <- vars[i, , drop=FALSE]
  cat(sprintf('<div class="gene-info-panel" data-variant-id="%s">',variant$variant_id)
  )
  cat(knitr::knit_child("gene-info.qmd", envir = list(variant = variant), quiet = TRUE))
  cat('</div>\n')
}
```

```{=html}
  </div>
</details>
```

```{=html}
<!-- ── Variant Info Section ─────────────────────────────── -->
<details markdown="1" id="variant-info" open>
  <summary>VARIANT INFO</summary>
  <div id="variant-body">
```

```{r, results='asis'}
# ── Variant Panels: wrap child QMD outputs ───────────────
for(i in seq_len(nrow(vars))) {
  variant <- vars[i, , drop=FALSE]
  cat(sprintf(
    '<div class="variant-info-panel" data-variant-id="%s">', variant$variant_id)
  )
  cat(knitr::knit_child("variant-info.qmd", envir = list(variant = variant), quiet = TRUE))
  cat('</div>\n')
}
```

```{=html}
  </div>
</details>
```


```{=html}
<!-- ── Read Viewer Section ────────────────────────────────── -->
<details markdown="1" id="read-viewer" open>
  <summary>READ VIEWER</summary>
  <div id="jigv-body">
```

```{r, results='asis'}
# ── Variant Panels: wrap child QMD outputs ───────────────
for(i in seq_len(nrow(vars))) {
  variant <- vars[i, , drop=FALSE]
  cat(sprintf(
    '<div class="jigv-panel" data-variant-id="%s">',
    variant$variant_id)
  )
  # inline the JIGV HTML
  jigv_html <- readr::read_file("jigv.html")
  iframe_tag <- htmltools::tags$iframe(
    srcdoc      = jigv_html,
    width       = "100%",
    height      = "600px",
    frameborder = "0",
    sandbox     = "allow-scripts allow-same-origin",
  )
  cat(htmltools::renderTags(iframe_tag)$html)
  cat('</div>\n')
}
```


```{=html}
  </div>
</details>
</div>
</div>
```
